stemMarkdown: The average weight of 15 students increases by 2.5 kg when a new student replaces one weighing 48 kg. What is the weight (in kg) of the new student?
solutionMarkdown: The total weight rises by $15 \times 2.5 = 37.5$ kg. That entire increase comes from one swap, so the new student is $37.5$ kg heavier than the one who left: $48 + 37.5 = 85.5$ kg.
